original_target.title: Are bounded ancient Landau–Coulomb distributions necessarily Maxwellians?

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.

sources.scope: Exact bounded ancient homogeneous Coulomb class with timewise weighted L1−1, no finite mass/energy.
Finite weighted integrability/Fisher information global existence does not classify locally finite-mass bounded ancient solutions.
Krieger–Strain isotropic model; explicitly says rigidity proof uses nonconservation of energy and does not apply to actual Landau.

registry_checks: Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI full metadata checked for ancient/kinetic/Landau aliases; no matching claim. Current arXiv, author/publisher, Zenodo, HAL, GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Original includes possible infinite mass/energy and all backward times; finite-mass global Cauchy regularity, near-Maxwellian linear stability and isotropic stationary rigidity do not settle it.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. Actual August rigidity theorem explicitly has a different operator.
